# beszel_alert (Resource)

Manages an alert threshold for a system, on behalf of a user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "beszel_alert" "example" {
  user   = beszel_user.example.id
  system = beszel_system.example.id
  name   = "CPU"
  value  = 90
  min    = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Kind of alert. One of Status, CPU, Memory, Disk, Temperature, Bandwidth, GPU, LoadAvg1, LoadAvg5, LoadAvg15, or Battery.
- `system` (String) ID of the monitored system the alert applies to.
- `user` (String) ID of the user the alert notifies.

### Optional

- `min` (Number) Minutes the threshold must be exceeded before the alert triggers.
- `value` (Number) Threshold value that triggers the alert.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) PocketBase record ID of the alert.
- `triggered` (Boolean) Whether the alert is currently in a triggered state.
